features: Recording to cloud storage (Google Drive, Dropbox)
Coax input resolutions: TVI 5MP/4MP/1080P/720P, CVI 4MP/1080P/720P, AHD 5MP/4MP/1080P/720P
Recording: 16ch 5MP Lite @12 fps, 16ch 4MP Lite/1080P @15 fps, 1080P Lite @25 fps
SMD+ (human/vehicle) on 16 channels; perimeter protection on 2 channels; line crossing/intrusion and face detection on 2 BNC channels
notes: 4 IP channels are available alongside the coax inputs. Maximum IP channel count left out.
Product page spec table states 8 TB; its highlights and the datasheet state 10 TB. Max HDD capacity left out.
Product page states up to 15 W without HDD; datasheet states up to 10 W. Power consumption left out.
